name: One Commendation Signet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText:
Very well - your deeds have been entered into the records, and you are duly recognized for your efforts. Keep up the good work, Champion.

If you have any more signets to hand in, then I am able to assist you further in that regard.
narrative.requestItemsText:
For those adventurers who have but a single commendation signet, I'll exchange it for a small amount of recognition with Thunder Bluff.

Please bear in mind that it is better to hand over a stack of ten signets at once; your efforts will receive greater recognition in doing so. We offer a single signet exchange as a service for those who don't have enough for a full stack of ten.

With that being said, I stand ready to assist you if you still wish to hand in a single signet.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 0 XP in all.
